name: Natsuki Leo
source: A student attending the same academy as the protagonist. He aspires to become a fashion designer. Possessing hidden creative talent, he dreams of astonishing the world with his innovative ideas. While cheerful and upbeat, he can occasionally be a bit rough around the edges.
